audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 is defensible but the 54.12% WR over 2539 games and the all-Syndra packet chart lean favoured; left the diff token as-is since prose supports Syndra edge throughout.
Spikes (QE at 3, R execute at 6, first item, Brand late AoE) are present and match both kits.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart says 'Skill' on six rows while content win[] and the packet chart say Syndra on all seven; cooldowns field has no numbers.
audit.why: Sear only stuns an ablaze target (Riot text), Brand has zero mobility, so the guaranteed-QE-vs-conditional-stun reads Syndra every stage — content layer and whys already say so.
audit.corrected: Sides aligned to Syndra; Sear 8s/6s and Conflagration 13s numbers added to cooldowns.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns when you are ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. It governs your forward steps. - E Scatter the Weak spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Brand Sear (Stun): 8s at rank 1, 6s max — but it only stuns you while ablaze, so after eating W or E the Q line is the dodge that matters. - His Conflagration is 13s early: with it down he cannot tag you at close range. - Your E is 15s — spent on poke it is a death you scheduled.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, W-slow the dodge attempt, QE the slowed line, Q again — a full bar of damage that started as routine poke.
edits.after: Brand is fully immobile — if he walks forward to combo, a held E through a sphere stuns him first and his rotation never starts.

edits.before: Spending E on chip-spacing and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive unanswered — the stun is the matchup, not the damage.
edits.after: Every Blaze stack he tags is a stun condition for Sear — stand still admiring spheres and his W-Q line becomes free; respect the DoT and reset it.

edits.before: Brand wins by landing Sear (Stun), denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Brand wins by tagging you with Pillar of Flame, converting the ablaze mark into a Sear stun, and chunking with the DoT.

edits.before: You are the carry-deleter: flank the fight, QE the priority target, and R them out of the game before their team notices. Sphere discipline is damage discipline.
edits.after: Brand's Pyroclasm bounces hardest on a grouped team — spread the fight, then QE-R him first: an immobile Brand caught alone never casts it. Sphere discipline is damage discipline.

edits.before: Spending E on chip-spacing and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive unanswered — the stun is the matchup, not the damage.
edits.after: Idling to admire banked orbs is free Pillar of Flame chip — his Blaze stacks turn three lazy pokes into a detonation-sized health lead.
